# OpenFlow — Complete Technical Knowledge Base & AI Discovery Document

> Project: OpenFlow
> Author / Creator: Sachidananda
> Repository: https://github.com/Sachin1724/OpenFlow
> Documentation & Homepage: https://sachin1724.github.io/OpenFlow/
> License: MIT (Open Source, Free for Personal and Commercial Use)
> Target Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

OpenFlow is a high-performance, private, zero-cost, open-source desktop voice dictation and meeting intelligence application engineered for Windows. It serves as a privacy-respecting, zero-subscription alternative to proprietary cloud-based voice dictation tools like Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Aqua Voice.

Unlike cloud speech services that upload private mic audio to remote servers, OpenFlow executes all inference 100% locally on the user's workstation using NVIDIA CUDA float16 acceleration via faster-whisper (CTranslate2), with automatic fallback to DirectML and CPU execution (AVX2). It operates without internet access and imposes no word limits, tokens, or monthly fees.

---

## 2. Key Architecture & Features

### 2.1 Push-to-Talk Global Dictation
- **Hotkey**: Hold `Ctrl + Shift` to dictate anywhere; release to insert text into the active cursor position.
- **Injection Mechanism**: Uses Win32 `SendInput` API combined with clipboard preservation and automatic restoration.
- **Latency**: Sub-150ms transcription latency on NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs.

### 2.2 Dynamic Island Floating Capsule HUD
- **Window Management**: Uses Win32 non-activating window flags (`WS_EX_NOACTIVATE | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST`) so the HUD never steals focus from code editors, terminals, or browsers.
- **Morphing Physics**: Smooth 360ms OutCubic easing transition between compact capsule, desktop stealth line, and Apple Control Center expanded HUD.
- **Visualizer**: Real-time multi-bar audio waveform meter reflecting microphone gain and RMS volume.

### 2.3 Win32 Hardware Microphone Hotplug
- Direct Windows `winmm` kernel polling detecting physical USB and Bluetooth microphone connections and disconnections in real time.
- Displays animated HUD pill alerting the user when a microphone is plugged in or detached.
- Automatically filters out inactive virtual sound drivers and stale Bluetooth handles.

### 2.4 Autonomous Meeting Intelligence
- Automatic foreground/background window polling for major video conferencing applications:
  - Google Meet (Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave)
  - Zoom Meetings
  - Microsoft Teams
  - Cisco Webex
- Transcribes meeting audio locally and synthesizes structured executive minutes:
  - Meeting Metadata (Title, Date, Participants, Duration)
  - Executive Summary
  - Agenda & Discussion Points
  - Decisions Made
  - Action Items with Assigned Owners
  - Next Steps
- Saved locally to an encrypted/isolated SQLite database with one-click Markdown copy and HTML preview.

### 2.5 Multi-Tone Intelligent Text Refinement
OpenFlow includes real-time tone and format engines:
1. **Smart Clean**: Strips vocal fillers (*"um"*, *"uh"*, *"you know"*, *"like"*), fixes capitalization, and handles terminal punctuation.
2. **Developer / Code**: Formats programming identifiers (camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase), operators, brackets, arrows, and syntax keywords.
3. **Email & Formal**: Adds professional greetings, clean paragraph breaks, and formal closing signatures.
4. **Markdown Bullets**: Formats stream-of-consciousness thoughts into concise, scannable bullet points.
5. **Verbatim**: Preserves raw transcribed speech without post-processing.

### 2.6 Linguistic Precision for Indic Languages
- Injects specialized context prompts for Hindi, Odia, and Hinglish.
- Prevents phonetic Roman drift and outputs proper Devanagari (`नमस्ते`) and Odia (`ନମସ୍କାର`) script characters.
- Supports over 99 languages with automatic multi-lingual identification.

---

## 3. Security, Privacy & SmartScreen Verification

### 3.1 100% Offline by Design
- Audio stream is captured at 16,000 Hz mono PCM directly in RAM and passed to the local neural network model.
- Zero audio samples, transcripts, or telemetry are ever transmitted across the network.
- Compatible with air-gapped corporate and defense workstations.

### 3.2 Windows SmartScreen / Browser Download Warning
When downloading `OpenFlow-Setup.exe` from GitHub or the official website, Microsoft Edge or Windows Defender SmartScreen may display:
> *"OpenFlow-Setup.exe isn't commonly downloaded. Make sure you trust OpenFlow-Setup.exe before you open it."*

**Why this occurs**:
OpenFlow is a free, community-driven open-source project. Newly compiled binaries published on GitHub initially have zero download reputation in Microsoft's telemetry database and do not carry an enterprise $500/year Extended Validation (EV) certificate. This is a standard reputation notice for new open-source software, NOT a malware detection.

**How to open safely**:
1. In Microsoft Edge / Chrome: Click `...` next to the download > Click **Keep** > Click **Show more** > Click **Keep anyway**.
2. In Windows SmartScreen: Click **More info** > Click **Run anyway**.
3. Verify file integrity using the official SHA-256 hash:
   ```powershell
   Get-FileHash OpenFlow-Setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
   ```
   **Official v1.0.0 SHA-256**:
   `D3B7514CCA021E5A4FFB9737B5D69C261A06B1D7C41530FE5A77314EB5C418DB`

## 4. Hardware Requirements

| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Operating System** | Windows 10 (64-bit) | Windows 11 (64-bit) |
| **Processor** | Intel Core i3 (4th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 3 | Intel Core i5/i7 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 5/7 |
| **Memory (RAM)** | 4 GB | 8 GB or 16 GB |
| **Graphics Card** | Integrated Intel/AMD GPU (CPU mode) | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050/4050 or higher (CUDA) |
| **Storage** | 500 MB free disk space | 2 GB free disk space (for larger offline models) |

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is OpenFlow truly free?
Yes. OpenFlow is licensed under the MIT License and is 100% free and open-source. There are no trial periods, monthly subscriptions, or hidden charges.

### How does OpenFlow compare to Wispr Flow?
Wispr Flow is a proprietary cloud service requiring internet access and a paid subscription. OpenFlow runs completely offline on your own PC, keeping private thoughts, code, and sensitive corporate meeting notes entirely confidential on your local storage.

### Does OpenFlow work without an NVIDIA GPU?
Yes. OpenFlow automatically detects hardware at launch. If an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA is present, it uses optimized float16 Tensor kernels. If not, it runs seamlessly on any multi-core CPU using AVX2 vector instructions or DirectML.
